title: Bartsch to Müller, 5 May 1631
author: Jacob Bartsch
source: Jacob Bartsch's letter to Philipp Müller written at Lauban on 5 May 1631, after the Swedish advance had driven him from Sagan: on settling Kepler's estate, sending copies of the *Somnium*, his own tables and the *Rudolphine Tables*, their prices, and Tycho Brahe's observations, now in his hands. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 10. G. 8). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 101–102.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Driven from Sagan by the war, Bartsch writes from Lauban about settling Kepler's estate, sends the *Somnium* and his own tables, discusses prices for the *Rudolphine Tables* and *Ephemerides*, and reports that he now has Tycho Brahe's observations.

notes.note: Tycho's heirs and Kepler's: the Emperor still owed both.
